Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap: renewal & expansion discussion

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to align on what success looks like for Spectra going into Q4. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks: 

Pain points we discussed:
- Token cost on high-volume embedding workflows is eating our margin on search and reranking.
- Latency spikes during morning batch windows (08:00–10:30 PT) affect user-facing search.
- Lack of predictable Dedicated capacity makes planning new features risky.

Goals for renewal/expansion:
- Lock in a Dedicated pool for embeddings + generation with predictable throughput.
- Evaluate caching/batching recommendations to cut unit cost ~20–30%.
- Pilot new long-context summarization workload for enterprise accounts by Nov.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you share the Q3 usage export (tokens/embeddings by day) so we can share with finance?
2) Draft proposal with pricing tiers for a Dedicated commitment and expected uplift for expansion (50–100M tokens/mo).
3) Proposed timeline for a canary rollout (technical deep-dive -> pilot -> full roll).

Appreciate it — looping in procurement (procurement@spectra.com) for visibility.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of ML Platforms, Spectra
alex.johnson@spectra.com

Alex — thanks for the clear summary, and glad the call was useful. Attaching the Q3 usage export and a draft proposal for the Dedicated + expansion path (see attachments). High-level items below and proposed next steps.

Attachments:
- Spectra-Usage-Q3-2026.pdf (export: daily tokens & embeddings, peak windows)
- Redwood-Proposal-Spectra-Q4-2026.pdf (draft pricing, commitment tiers, rollout plan)

Key notes from our side:
- We estimate a 22–28% unit cost reduction by combining a Dedicated embeddings pool with automatic prefix/KV caching for your search workloads. Exact savings depend on average sequence lengths — the usage export will help tune this.
- For the latency spikes, our recommended short-term mitigation is request-level routing to a higher-priority Dedicated tier for the 08:00–10:30 PT window and enabling continuous batching with a max-latency guard.
- For the summarization pilot, we suggest a 4-week canary on a 5% sample of traffic, then expand to 25% if SLOs are met.

Proposed immediate timeline:
1) This week: I’ll share the proposal (attached) and schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra team — 60 min.
2) Week of 09/27: Pilot kickoff (4 weeks).
3) Week of 10/25: Review pilot metrics; finalize commitment/contract.

Next steps for Alex/Procurement:
- Review attached usage export + proposal.
- Suggested date for technical deep-dive: Tue 09/22 or Wed 09/23 (please confirm).
- If procurement wants a PO intent ahead of the contract, we can accept a PO for the Reserved commitment to lock pricing.

Looping in Marissa on the commercial details.

Best,
Ben
